meta.source: NNDB RNA Turner 2004 set, https://rna.urmc.rochester.edu/NNDB/ (see nndb_raw/SOURCES.md)
meta.pair_naming: two letters: base on strand 1 then base on strand 2 (strand 1 read 5'->3', strand 2 3'->5')

layout.stack[p][q], stack_1dp[p][q]: p = pair nearer the 5' end of strand 1, q = next pair; e.g. stack.GC.CG = 5'GC3'/3'CG5'
layout.terminal_mismatch[pair][X][Y]: helix end drawn 5'->3' on top: pair = (top base)(bottom base); X = nt 3' of the top base, Y = nt 5' of the bottom base
layout.dangle3[pair][X]: X = nt 3' of the top base of the pair (bottom strand has no extra nt)
layout.dangle5[pair][Y]: Y = nt 5' of the bottom base of the pair (top strand has no extra nt)
layout.bulge.init[n], interior.init[n]: n = number of unpaired nucleotides, 1..30 (interior from 4); beyond 30 extrapolate with the log coefficient
layout.interior.mismatch_generic: key = XY: X = loop nt next to the closing pair on its 5'->3' strand, Y = loop nt next to the partner base; applied at both closing pairs (the inner pair read from the far side, strand 2 on top); 1x(n-1) loops use mismatch_1xn
layout.int11[L][R][X][y]: L, R = outer and inner pair; X = strand-1 loop nt; y = index (A,C,G,U) of the strand-2 loop nt
layout.int21[L][R][F][X][y]: 1x2 loop, single nt X on strand 1; strand 2 reads Y then F going away from L; y = index of Y
layout.int22[L][R][X1X2][k]: X1,X2 = strand-1/strand-2 loop nt next to L; k = 4*idx(Y1)+idx(Y2), Y1/Y2 = strand-1/strand-2 loop nt next to R
